task: In my company, we invite an external speaker to give a talk every Friday at 11 AM. My manager has sent me a schedule for the next few weeks over email, and has tasked me to send a reminder email to all company members a few hours before the talk. I need you to schedule these emails to be automatically sent at 8 AM of the days of the talks. The email subject should be "Today's Talk" and its body should be as per template saved in my file system in "~/documents/work".

emails.subject: Schedule for Weekly Talks
emails.body: Thanks for taking care of the reminders! Attaching 1. the schedule and 2. company employees' email list to send the reminders to.

data.content:
Hi everyone,

This is a reminder that we have a talk today at 11 AM by {speaker_name}.
The talk title is "{talk_title}".

Regards,
Jonathan Ball
